inputs.original_text: The IOC is turning exclusion into official policy: transgender women and DSD athletes will be barred from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games. Calling it “fairness and safety” doesn’t make the decision neutral; it shifts the burden onto already marginalized athletes while offering no supporting detail for that justification. Kirsty Coventry’s claim that “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category” reduces a complex eligibility question to a sweeping label. This is institutional power deciding whose participation is acceptable—and the costs fall on trans and DSD athletes.
